name: Datum Plot
tagline: Analyse data and make publication-ready graphs: statistics, regression, curve fitting and page layouts, in one app for Windows.
for: Scientists, researchers, lab teams and students.
highlights: A linked chain: data tables → analyses → results → graphs → layouts. Change a value and every result and graph updates.
Statistics: descriptive, normality, outliers, t-tests, nonparametric tests, one- and two-way ANOVA with multiple comparisons, contingency tables, correlation, power, Bland-Altman and ROC.
Linear regression and curve fitting with a model library or your own equation, global fits and model comparison; multiple, logistic and Poisson regression on tables of many variables.
Materials testing: tensile tests, Weibull strength and Arrhenius activation energies.
Publication graphs: error bars, axis breaks, a second Y axis, annotations, colour-blind-safe colours, multi-panel figures and insets.
Page layouts at journal sizes; export as PNG or TIFF (with CMYK), SVG, PDF or EPS.
Interactive graphs: zoom, pan, drag notes and exclude points with a right-click.
Free and open source (MIT), Windows first, installs in seconds with Python inside, and updates itself.
